violation_type.title: Household Members Qualifications - Counted in Ratio Meet Assistant Caregiver Qualifications (26 TAC §747.1401(b))
violation_type.short_title: Household Members Qualifications - Counted in Ratio Meet Assistant Caregiver Qualifications
violation_type.typical_finding: While conducting an inspection a person was observed performing caregiver duties with children in care. This was corrected during the inspection when the person was removed.

finding_variants.text: While conducting an inspection a person was observed performing caregiver duties with children in care. This was corrected during the inspection when the person was removed.
One household memebr counted in ratio did nothave training.
While reviewing records there was no training for a person that was observed displaying caregiver duties with children in care.
